0.description: [Pending Restart] Added Dynamic Dummies to all major cities.

[Pending Restart] Added a new type of Training Dummy - Dynamic Dummies. These dummies are level 1 and do not scale with the active expansion, but rather with the level of the attacking player. When attacked by a player of any level, whether it's 60, 70, or 44, the dummies adjust their level and stats to match the attacking player. This feature allows leveling players to use these dummies just as endgame players can use the "Normal" dummies. Once the combat ends, these dummies reset back to level 1, ready for the next player to attack.

[Pending Restart] Healing Dummies (Wounded Dummies) will now cause a player healing them to enter combat. This change enables addons like Skada and Recount to track combat logs with default options. Healing dummies are now uninteractible by default. Player are able to activate and deactivate them by poking them (/poke).

[Pending Restart] Tank Dummies now cause players taking damage from them to generate rage. Tank dummies will now deal damage to players as any other creature, causing them to take damage as if they fell below certain health percentages for proc talents to trigger. They can also inflict damage as if they actually killed their target, displaying overkill effects and triggering on-death effects. Tank dummies are now correctly affected by attack-speed reducing effects, increasing time between attacks.

[Pending Restart] Replaced all Training Dummies in the game with new versions. All "Normal", Execute, Tank, and Healing Training Dummies now update their levels and stats (armor, hit requirement, attack power) to the currently active expansion.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Items] Reworked the Fist Weapon Set of Fist and Claw of Molten Fury. Both weapons now have a weapon speed of 2.6, and the off-hand has had its minimum and maximum damage adjusted accordingly. Both weapons have had their agility converted into attack power and critical strike rating for the main-hand, and haste rating for the off-hand. The set effect's cooldown has been reduced to 30 seconds, down from 45 seconds. The proc now inflicts a small amount of base Fire damage + 20% of Weapon damage as Fire damage, and it now scales with attack power and spell power. Previously, it would inflict 10% of Weapon damage as Fire damage without additional scaling. The original version of this effect would inflict 100-125 Fire damage without additional scaling. The different versions of this weapons are now interchangeable, allowing you to wield for example a Normal version in the off-hand and a Heroic version in the main-hand to benefit from its effect.

Starting from Phase Three, Prince Malchezaar now attempts to decapitate his primary target, throwing Gorehowl after it and inflicting 300% Weapon damage after a 4-second cast time. Damage is reduced the further the target is away from Prince Malchezaar. Decapitate will occur 16 seconds into phase three and be cast every 30 seconds thereafter.

Removing Enfeeble by any means causes the target to suffer 90% of its current health in Shadow damage. The duration has been increased to 60 seconds, up from 10.
